long_description: Study showed that it had influence on wake-up times and, as a internal clock, may be associated with a preference for daytime or nighttime activity. The PER1 gene orchestra dictates the optimum times for everything from athletic performance, shaving, taking medicine to cramming for an exam. This fact might be anecdotical but in our society, understanding and leveraging the power of these biological sleep patterns would be good for public health and productivity. What are you? title: Ci-lantro vs No-lantro
study: From the study of Nicholas Eriksson et al. 23andMe, US
short_description: Does cilantro (or coriander) tastes like it should… or like soap?
long_description: How come though? Widely used in cuisines from many different countries, from Indian curries, to Mexican salsas, and Moroccan tagines, cilantro is a make or break kind of condiment. The description of what cilantro tastes like ranges from “comet cleanser” to “rancid body odor” and “burnt plastic and blood”. No wonder that date was a disaster! But difference in flavor is no longer a mystery or simply a “matter of taste,” after analyzing the genomes of thousands of people, recent studies have found that this soapy and/or disgusting flavor that some people describe when eating cilantro has to do with a group of olfactory-receptor genes which some people share, while others don’t.

title: SAPDA
short_description: SAPDA is a new ancestry inference software developed by Dilawer Khan. It is unlike any of the other currently available ancestry inference programs.
long_description: SAPDA is a new ancestry inference software developed by Dilawer Khan. It is unlike any of the other currently available ancestry inference programs. By using outgroup populations SAPDA removes old mutations which are common to many worldwide populations. In doing this shared old mutations which can confound more recent ancestry inference are removed. SAPDA SOFTWARE FEATURES & BENEFITS OVER CURRENTLY AVAILABLE CALCULATORS Use of multiple outgroup populations to increase certainty of mutations specific to various populations; User receives graphical evidence of genes shared with other populations in support of admixture percentage calculations; Filtration of old mutations common to many populations in admixture calculations; Single population sharing output (GSI) to more accurately quantify admixture percentages; Mitigation of ascertainment bias inherent in public SNP arrays. For additional information about SAPDA please refer to EurasianDNA.com

title: K5 Admixture
short_description: In contrast to commercial ancestry tests and other Admixture program based calculators, the Eurasia K5 is designed to detect TOTAL DEEPER RELATEDNESS between the test subject and the aforementioned divergent populations than other tests.
long_description: The Eurasia K5 admixture calculator was specifically designed to measure relatedness of individuals to highly diverged populations of Eurasia, to wit: 1- West Eurasians 2- South Eurasians 3- East Eurasians 4- Eastern Siberians & Native Americans 5- Basal Eurasians & Africans Differences between the Eurasia K5, commercial ancestry tests, and other Admixture program based calculators: In contrast to commercial ancestry tests and other Admixture program based calculators, the Eurasia K5 is designed to detect TOTAL DEEPER RELATEDNESS between the test subject and the aforementioned divergent populations than other tests. Commercial DNA ancestry tests can detect East or South Asian ancestry in Europeans or West Asians only if there is recent admixture, however they are not designed to find older such ancestry that may have introgressed during Medieval, Iron Age, Bronze Age, or Neolithic times. Similarly other Admixture program based calculators do the same. The reason for this is that a test subject's DNA is compared to many other West Asian or European populations and many South or East Asian DNA segments go unreported because they are incorporated into the West Asian or European references via older admixture from Iron Age Steppe nomads or Turkic migrations into West Asia and Europe. In other words these older East or South Asian DNA segments are not reported under East or South Asian in the test subject's test results. This calculator seeks to find those older East Eurasian, South Eurasian, Siberian, and Basal Eurasian/African segments in the user's DNA. Similarly, this test also seeks to find older West Eurasian, Siberian, and Basal Eurasian DNA segments in East Asian users. Ditto for testers from the Americas and Africa. In "Paleolithic DNA from the Caucasus reveals core of West Eurasian ancestry", Supplementary Information, Tables S4.2-S4.5, Lazaridis et al, 2018, the authors showed via formal statistics that most West Asian and European populations including ancient ones have some older East Asian and Siberian related admixture. The Eurasia K5 test is also able to detect this older admixture unlike commercial ancestry testing companies such as 23andMe or AncestryDNA, and unlike most other Admixture based calculators.

title: MTHFR Insights
short_description: This app offers insights into the MTHFR gene mutation based on genomic data. An MTHFR gene mutation could affects the body's ability to properly process folate, leading to potentially elevated levels of homocysteine in the blood due to impaired enzyme function.
long_description: This app offers insights into the MTHFR gene mutation based on genomic data. An MTHFR gene mutation is a variation in the methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) gene that affects the body's ability to properly process folate (vitamin B9), leading to potentially elevated levels of homocysteine in the blood due to impaired enzyme function. This can be associated with a range of health concerns depending on the severity of the mutation and individual factors, including potential risks for cardiovascular disease, neural tube defects, and certain psychiatric conditions.

title: MY GENESIS ORIGINS TEST PACKAGE - Beginner
short_description: The MY GENESIS ORIGINS BEGINNER TEST SERIES is the most detailed and extensive ancient DNA test series that employs ancient DNA from real ancient people who lived in each specific era to help you discover your genesis origins (50,000-300 BC).
long_description: The MY GENESIS ORIGINS TEST SERIES (PALEOLITHIC - BRONZE AGE) is the most detailed and extensive ancient DNA test series that employs ancient DNA from real ancient people who lived in each specific era to help you discover your genesis origins (50,000-300 BC). The name of the series is derived from the large number of gene pools that are mentioned in Genesis 10, including Canaan (Mesolithic Origins Test), Kush, Tiras, Shem, Riphath, and Gog and Magog (Early and Late Neolithic Origin Tests). What will I get? Included in this test series are our six best tests: Paleolithic Origins ( Basic : 5 Gene pools and 10 cultures. Advanced: 8 Gene pools and 22 cultures) Mesolithic Origins ( Basic : 5 Gene pools and 10 cultures. Advanced : 8 Gene pools and 22 cultures) Early Neolithic Origins ( Basic : 6 Gene pools and 9 cultures. Advanced : 8 Gene pools and 22 cultures) Late Neolithic Origins ( Basic : 6 Gene pools and 9 cultures. Advanced : 8 Gene pools and 22 cultures) Copper Origins ( Basic : 5 Gene pools and 10 cultures. Advanced : 8 Gene pools and 22 cultures) Bronze Origins ( Basic : 6 Gene pools and 7 cultures. Advanced : 8 Gene pools and 25 cultures) Overall, our Basic tests include 21 Gene Pools and 55 cultures, and our Advanced tests include 40 Gene Pools and 135 cultures. How is your test different from other tests? How does it work? With our revolutionary paleogenomics technology, we've embarked on a groundbreaking journey into the past, unraveling the mysteries of ancient civilizations like never before. Through the meticulous analysis of a unique set of mutations present in thousands of ancient individuals who lived between 50,000 and 300 BC, we identified regional signatures that represent the ancient ancestries of each era, which we call gene pools. The genome of everyone, ancient or modern person, is represented as a combination of these gene pools (ranging from 0% to 100%). By calculating your ancient gene pools from each era and comparing you to hundreds of cultures around the world, we can connect you with your ancient ancestors. Our cutting-edge approach to paleogenomics allows us to delve deeper than any other test into the genetic makeup of ancient populations of each era and unlock the secrets of their origins, migrations, and interactions with one another. Why are ancient cultures different from one another if they lived at the same time? Because mating was mostly within tribes that did not interact with each other, over time, genetic differences were created between populations even if they lived at the same time. Therefore, different cultures have varying proportions of regional components, which allows us to characterize those cultures and compare their genetic makeup with yours. In that way, we can find, for example, the Bronze Age cultures that are most genetically similar to your Bronze Age genomic makeup. What is the difference between Basic and Advanced Tests? We designed our tests for beginners and advanced users. The beginner tests are cheaper and include fewer gene pools and cultures, while our advanced tests include the complete set of gene pools and cultures. Who developed the tests? All our tests were developed by Dr. Eran Elhaik, an expert in Population, medical, and evolutionary genomics with over 20 years of experience developing genetic tests, including Genographic's Geno 2.0 , GPS Origins , and Ancient DNA Origins . As a pioneer in the field, Dr. Elhaik's research has been published in prestigious scientific journals, earning him international acclaim for his contributions to advancing genomic science. His commitment to excellence and his unwavering dedication to scientific rigor ensure that our tests adhere to the highest standards of quality and accuracy. With Dr. Elhaik at the helm, you can trust that our tests are scientifically rigorous and meticulously designed to provide you with the most comprehensive insights into your genetic heritage.
